Definition: contracted superlative of G4253; foremost (in time, place, order or importance):--before, beginning, best, chief(-est), first (of all), former.
BiblicalUsage: Protos means first, foremost, chief, beginning. Jesus says, Seek ye first the kingdom of God, and His righteousness, and all these things shall be added unto you, and the last shall be first, and the first last. John the Baptist said of Jesus, He that cometh after me is preferred before me, for He was before me, and Paul says, I delivered unto you first of all that which I also received, how that Christ died for our sins. And the risen Lord says, I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end, the first and the last.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe first is the word that orders everything: seek the kingdom first, and the rest is added. I hold that Christ is first in every sense that matters, before John, before the world, first from the dead, and first in my life, or He is not first at all.
